    need(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), "regular file required: " + str(path))
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:

            digest.update(chunk)
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": digest.hexdigest()}
